name: BK-5Br-NM-AMT
summary: BK-5Br-NM-AMT, or βk-5Br-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-5-bromo-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-5-bromo-β-ketotryptamine, is a monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and β-ketotryptamine families.

pharmacology.text: BK-5Br-NM-AMT, or βk-5Br-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-5-bromo-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-5-bromo-β-ketotryptamine, is a monoamine releasing agent of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and β-ketotryptamine families.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied for how it releases monoamines. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討它如何釋放單胺類物質，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨它如何释放单胺类物质，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is alpha-methyltryptamine with a bromine added to the ring and an oxygen double bonded to the side chain. Adding that beta keto group usually makes a compound release monoamines rather than act on receptors directly.
fact.zh: 它是在 α-甲基色胺的環上加一個溴，並在側鏈上以雙鍵接一個氧。加上這個 β 酮基通常會讓化合物轉為釋放單胺類，而非直接作用於受體。
fact.zhHans: 它是在 α-甲基色胺的环上加一个溴，并在侧链上以双键接一个氧。加上这个 β 酮基通常会让化合物转为释放单胺类，而非直接作用于受体。
